# Preview runtime

Three.js **0.170.0** and the required GLTFLoader, OrbitControls, RoomEnvironment and BufferGeometryUtils modules are vendored for an offline-capable local model preview. Original files are from the published `three@0.170.0` npm package via jsDelivr. Copyright and MIT terms are retained in [THREE-LICENSE.txt](THREE-LICENSE.txt).

No dependency is loaded from a remote CDN by the model viewer at runtime. Browser rendering still requires WebGL and a local HTTP server.
